description: Replay sequentially using OpenClaw browser tool with one labeled targetId. Prefix navigate URLs with task-owned local preview origin. Assertions throw on actual rendered failures. No provider calls or record mutations. Other editor save/cancel regression evidence in phase2/rendered-regression-results.json.

steps.fn: async()=>{document.querySelector('.v-sidebar a[href="/business"]').click();for(let i=0;i<120&&location.pathname!=='/business';i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));if(location.pathname!=='/business')throw Error('Navigation failed');history.back();for(let i=0;i<120&&(location.pathname!=='/customers'||document.querySelector('main h1')?.textContent!=='Customers');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));if(location.pathname!=='/customers')throw Error('Back failed');return {back:true,path:location.pathname};}

()=>{const client=document.documentElement.clientWidth,scroll=document.documentElement.scrollWidth;if(scroll>client)throw Error('Page overflow at '+innerWidth);const header=[...document.querySelectorAll('header a,header button,header input')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0).map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().top);if(header.some((y,i)=>i>0&&y<header[i-1]-10))throw Error('Header reading order mismatch');return {width:innerWidth,client,scroll,readingOrder:true};}
